name: Prism Current
scope: Four difficulty profiles, Easy first-play default, slower fruit-launching enemies, cuttable/shootable blocks instead of red missiles, one-time healing boxes, readable scene health bar and late-only boss entrances. Existing graphics and old scores preserved; new records are difficulty-specific. Status textures update only when their contents change and are uploaded during loading before the soundtrack. Direct B/Y start/resume is no longer discarded by a preceding pointer-action debounce; native selection latches and controller/visibility checks remain. AR Tide adds an intentional two-island/two-cloud Duck Armada AR setting, a saved minimal-scenery option, and reversible water-optics refinement without changing gameplay or the headset camera. AR Tide 0.1.1 adds two small grounded grass patches using shared clock-driven wind and prebuilt XR detail, without changing scores, difficulty, controls or audio. AR Field Guide adds three readable curved object cards to the AR pre-battle menu and paused Controls view. They never intercept controls and are hidden throughout combat. Color Match adds direct per-hand color switching, symbol-marked blades and fruit, additive matching bonuses, explicit score feedback and a separate new scoring board; all older records remain read-only and preserved. Clear Shoals upgrades the existing water optics with original pebble-bed detail, loading-time refracted-light caustics, filtered micro-wave slopes and dielectric reflection, preserving geometric waves, AR opacity and all Color Match gameplay.
